name: button-3d
summary: A keycap-style button whose lit face sinks into its edge when pressed.
props: Label, a single glyph (circle buttons) or custom content.
Keycap material; auto is light on dark screens and dark on light ones. Glass is for buttons on photos.
A custom face colour instead of a material, e.g. your brand colour.
Keycap, pill or round icon button.
Show a spinner and ignore taps.
Dim the button and ignore taps.
Light haptic tap on press (iOS / Android).
Label for screen readers (needed for icon-only buttons).
behavior: The face sinks into its edge on press-in and springs back on release. Small sizes pad their hit area to 44pt.
A light impact on press-in on iOS and on press on Android, so scrolling past it doesn't buzz. Turn off with haptics={false}.
A button with disabled and busy state. Pass accessibilityLabel for circle keys that show only a glyph.
usage:
import { Button3D } from '@/components/ui/button-3d';

<Button3D size="lg" shape="pill" onPress={startTrip}>
  Start the trip
</Button3D>
